subject: EdgeConductor — Private deployment pricing & packaging proposal
messages:
From: Claire Sutton <claire.sutton@edgeconductor.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@edgeconductor.ai, Benjamin Ross <benjamin.ross@edgeconductor.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment RFP and commercial questions

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Attaching our RFP (Attachment: EdgeConductor_RFP.pdf) — high level asks are below:

- Private/VPC deployment (multi-region): target pilot in Q3, production by end of Q4
- Licensing: prefer a mix of site/operator licenses + per-GPU node credits for edge sites
- Platform fee: need clarity on amortization and accounting (CapEx vs OpEx)
- Support tiers: what does Premier include vs Standard (oncall response windows, escalation SLA, proactive QBRs)
- Pilot discount: we have a 12-week pilot — is there a pilot pricing concession and how does it apply to final committed pricing?

Can you share a proposal and a sample SOW/terms that we can show Procurement? Also attaching a short network diagram (in the RFP).

Cheers,
Claire
Claire Sutton
Head of Infrastructure
EdgeConductor

Attachment: EdgeConductor_RFP.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Claire Sutton <claire.sutton@edgeconductor.ai>
Cc: Benjamin Ross <benjamin.ross@edgeconductor.ai>, procurement@edgeconductor.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment RFP and commercial questions

Hi Claire — thanks for the RFP. High-level response inline + attached starter pricing spreadsheet (Attachment: Redwood_PrivDeploy_Pricing_v1.xlsx).

Short answers first:
- Licensing model: we can offer a blended construct — operator licenses for central control plane teams + node credits for GPU sites. For your multi-region pilot we recommend 3 operator licenses + 10 node credits to start.
- Platform fee: we propose an amortized platform fee applied over 12 months for pilots moving to commit; we can also invoice monthly for OpEx accounting — flexible by mutual agreement.
- Support tiers: Standard = business hours + 24h ticket SLA; Premier = 24/7 oncall + 2hr critical response + 1 named SRE retainer (monthly).
- Pilot concession: we can do a 15% pilot discount on platform fee and node credits if you convert to a 12-month committed purchase within 30 days of pilot close.

Next steps: I27ve attached the spreadsheet with three pricing scenarios (pilot only, 12-month committed, and 24-month commit with volume break). If helpful, I can set a 30-minute walk-through next week to go line-by-line.

Regards,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
T: 415-555-0192

Attachment: Redwood_PrivDeploy_Pricing_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: EdgeConductor pricing posture — recommended counter

Tessa / David,

Quick internal note before we finalize the external counter. I reviewed Claire27s RFP and your draft pricing. A few recommendations to keep negotiation headroom while staying competitive:

- Pilot discount: 15% on platform fee + 10% on node credits is reasonable, but make conversion window 21 days (not 30). Shorter window increases urgency and reduces revenue risk.
- Platform fee amortization: offer both options in the SOW: (A) amortize over 12 months with monthly invoicing; (B) single upfront invoice for customers that prefer CapEx treatment. Include an optional 6-month ramp credit if they do multi-site onboarding later.
- Support: push Premier to include a 1/quarter executive QBR and 2 named escalation contacts; price SRE retainer as optional add-on at a fixed monthly rate to avoid embedded high fixed costs.
- Added clause: include a capacity-burst credit bucket (pre-purchased) for edge spikes — attractive for edge-first customers.

If we need to move price, prioritize discounting node credits vs platform fee — platform fee funds our support and roadmap. With David, can you confirm the SRE retainer rate and if legal is ok with 21-day conversion?

-Markus
VP, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Private deployment RFP and commercial questions

Claire — thank you for the clear RFP and timeline. We27ve updated the proposal based on internal feedback and here27s our formal offer and next steps: 

Summary offer (pilot -> committed path)
- Pilot (12 weeks): 15% discount on platform fee + 10% discount on node credits. Pilot includes 3 operator licenses and 10 node credits.
- Conversion: if EdgeConductor signs a 12-month commitment within 21 days of pilot close we will apply a one-time credit equal to the pilot platform fee (effectively amortizing pilot cost into year 1).
- Platform fee: two invoicing options included in SOW (amortized monthly over 12 months OR single upfront invoice). See SOW section 2.3 for accounting language.
- Support tiers:
  - Standard: business-hours support, 24h ticket SLA, monthly health check
  - Premier: 24/7 oncall, 2hr critical response, 1 named SRE retainer (optional, billed monthly), quarterly exec QBRs, SLA credit for critical incidents (see SOW).
- Add-on: Burst credit bucket available as pre-purchased node credits at a 5% discount vs list.

Commercials attached: Redwood_PrivDeploy_Pricing_v1.xlsx and a draft SOW (PDF) in the Drive link below.

Next steps
1) If this matches your expectations, I27ll schedule a 30-min pricing walk-through next Tue (6/16) and share a DocuSign link for a preliminary LOI.
2) Procurement can review the SOW and we27ll loop in Legal for any redlines.
